import ctypes
import os

# Load the GSL libraries
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_sf_bessel_Yn function
# int gsl_sf_bessel_Yn(const int n, const double x)
gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_Yn.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_Yn.restype = ctypes.c_double

def compute_bessel_Yn(n, x):
    if x <= 0:
        raise ValueError("x must be positive")
    return gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_Yn(n, x)
